batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2016-2017, Set-12 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.193-199 (printed pp.8-14 of Part 2). Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); the two forms never disagree in this paper, and exactly one question (Q61) carries both forms, which agree on (a). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in two syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.193) carries 68 questions and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.198, continuing on p.199) carries the remaining 12 (Q44, 48, 52, 53, 57, 59, 60, 71, 72, 73, 76, 80); together they partition the printed numbers 1-80 exactly once, and each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. No 'Old Syllabus' block occurs in this paper. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, General Knowledge Q7-14, Chemistry Q15-36, Physics Q37-58, Higher Mathematics Q59-80 — counts Bangla 3, English 3, General Knowledge 8, Chemistry 22, Physics 22, Higher Mathematics 22. NOTE the block ORDER differs from the sibling Set-4 paper: here Chemistry (Q15-36) precedes Physics (Q37-58). Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.193 carries Q1-12; p.194 carries Q13-27; p.195 carries Q28-38; p.196 carries Q39-43, 45-47, 49-51, 54-56; p.197 carries Q58, 61-69; p.198 carries Q70, 74, 75, 77-79 and (Extra Syllabus) Q44, 48; p.199 carries (Extra Syllabus) Q52, 53, 57, 59, 60, 71-72, 73, 76, 80. Keys: 74 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 0 keyless, and exactly SIX printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q21, Q37, Q42, Q47 and Q70 (printed solutions headed 'সমাধান: (No Correct Answer)') and Q72 (Extra Syllabus, 'সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'); those six carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (the printed solution's no-answer statement), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Only ONE question carries figure options: Q34, whose four options are printed structural diagrams (described in brackets in the option texts, not redrawn). Preserved print anomalies: Q17(c) prints the product grouped as 'Na2(SO)4'; Q29(b) prints '(CH3)3-COOH' (the central C does not appear); Q43(d) prints the mantissa 6.455 against the 6.465 of options (a)-(c); Q60's printed solution rewrites the stem's ^5C3 as ^5C2; Q9's printed solution computes 40,212 km yet keys (a) 40,000; Q38 and Q40 print the angular units as 'rads^-1'/'rads^-2'; Q31's content is general-knowledge flavoured although its printed number places it in the Chemistry block, Q48's content is general-knowledge flavoured although its printed number places it in the Physics block, and Q79's content is physics flavoured although its printed number places it in the Higher Mathematics block. BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF p.192 (printed p.7) is the last page of the previous paper, JU A Unit 2016-2017 Set-4, and book PDF p.200 opens the next paper, JU A Unit 2015-2016 Set-5; neither is part of this paper. This paper's Q80 is the last item on book PDF p.199. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section, banner 'প্রশ্ন-সমাধান: ২০১৬-১৭') restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-12 of JU A Unit 2016-2017 occupies printed pp.8-14 = book PDF pp.193-199: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.193-198 (banner on p.193) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning on printed p.13 (book PDF p.198) and continuing on printed p.14 (book PDF p.199). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.193) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৬-২০১৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট-A, সেট-12, সময়: ১:০০ ঘণ্টা. The previous paper, Set-4, ends on printed p.7 (book PDF p.192) and the following paper, JU A Unit 2015-2016 Set-5, begins on book PDF p.200. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image, with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at 200%) for Q1-Q7, Q17-Q24, Q28-Q29, Q34, Q42-Q46, Q61-Q66 and Q73-Q76. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical formulas written with plain digits for subscripts, e.g. H2SO4).
